figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY budget_cents DESC

parts.note: 先把名为 a 的中间结果算出来，供后面的查询引用。
